utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Repair drive? I'm sorry, I think I forgot—what's it for again?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: It's a community effort to fix broken household items and reduce waste. Cleo's been gathering materials and tools for it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive! I think I have a broken toaster somewhere. I'll try to find it and bring it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Noah, it's great to see you're interested. I've been cataloging what we have so far; we could use more hands in sorting.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sorting? Is that what we're doing? I thought we were fixing things.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We'll get to fixing, but first we need to sort through what we have to know what tools and parts are available.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hey Gus, the repair drive is Saturday at 10. You in?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You bet I'm in! My tools are all prepped and ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, see you there.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Sam, are you planning to join us for the tool repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: For sure, I'll be there. I'm good with fixing tools.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, Sam! Glad to have your skills. We'll see you there at 10 AM.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, postponed? I hadn't heard that. When did they announce it?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Postponed? I thought it was still on for this weekend—Vik just asked me about it earlier.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Really? I was sure I saw a notice it was pushed back. Let me check.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You thinking of bringing anything? I've got an old toaster that's been sitting in my garage for ages.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good. But do we have a set time for this repair drive? I'd like to know when to be there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, it's Saturday from 9 to 3 at the community center parking lot. I'm bringing my old toaster!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Opal, did you hear about the repair drive this weekend? I think they're fixing up the playground equipment.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, I heard! It's actually Saturday morning at the community center parking lot. I think Jules might be checking the Henderson place for tools.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Good to know, thanks Opal. I'll let Bo know he can bring his tools there on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, next Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, I'll be there. What tools should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Just basic stuff—screwdrivers, maybe a hammer.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Rey, I'm organizing a repair drive this Saturday at 10 am to fix the playground swings and slide. Want to join?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I heard about it. Is it the one at the community center or the playground?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It's at the playground, not the community center.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Rosa, are you coming to the repair drive this weekend? I'm bringing my old toaster.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hey Vik! Yes, I'll be there Saturday morning at the community center parking lot. I'll take a look at that toaster for you!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great! I'll also bring my toolbox and some spare screws, just in case.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Quinn, did you get a cost estimate for that drive repair?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Not yet, but I'm hoping to get a rough idea from the sign-up sheet—will you add your name?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure, I'll sign up. But what's the ballpark cost for the drive repair?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Have we figured out who's bringing the tools for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Gus has a bunch of tools in his garage. I can help carry them to the neighbors who need them.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's good to hear. Do we have a list of what tools Gus has, and which neighbors specifically need them?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I'm thinking of bringing my old blender. Do you know if they fix small kitchen appliances?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Hmm, I'm not sure about small appliances—maybe check the sign-up sheet Quinn is starting? I'd hate for you to drag that blender over only to find out they only handle power tools.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That's a good idea. I'll look for Quinn's sheet first.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, Kira! I've got all my tools ready in the garage—just let me know what you need fixed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are we sure this repair drive is still on? I heard it got postponed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No, it's still on! I just checked with the organizers this morning.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yes, it's this Saturday at the community center parking lot from 9 to 3. They'll take anything with a plug!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, I'll swing by the Henderson place to see if there are any old tools that might still work.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That's a good idea! The Hendersons always have a bunch of old stuff lying around.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: So, Vik, do you have a list of the specific damages for the playground equipment?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, I don't have a list for the playground, but I'm definitely on for the repair drive with my toaster and toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: A toaster? Are you planning to fix that too, or is it for snacks while we work?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Ira, did you get the car fixed?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Not yet, but I'm hoping someone at the repair drive on Saturday might give me a hand.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What's wrong with it? And how much is it going to cost?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Huh, the repair drive? I think I heard something about that. What's it for again?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: It's a community thing—we're fixing up tools and helping neighbors with repairs. Gus has a bunch of tools ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. So we're meeting at Gus's place? Or did I get that wrong?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Quinn, I'm organizing a repair drive for the school playground this Saturday at 10. Would you be interested in helping out?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I'm in! I'll help spread the word and we can get a sign-up sheet going for supplies.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That's great, Quinn! Let's meet at the playground a bit before 10 to set up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Uli, are you free this weekend to help out at the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, next Saturday. I can help for a bit.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great! We're meeting at the community center at 10am. Bring any tools you'd like to fix or just come and lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, Dane, I'm with you—I'd like to know the exact time myself. Quinn, any update on that rough timeline?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: My car's good to go now, so I'm free to lend a hand on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, Sam, glad you're in. But I still need that timeline from Quinn to know when we're actually starting.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard there's a repair drive happening. What's that all about?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Neighbors bring broken stuff. We fix it together with tools.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds like a great way to help each other out! Where can I drop off my broken toaster?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, I've reserved the community center for Saturday from 10 AM to 4 PM. Does that work for you?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, that time works great for me. I'll also make sure to stop by the Henderson place to see if there's any usable tools we can bring.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Opal! That's really thoughtful of you. Let me know what you find at the Hendersons'.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive! I remember now—I have a rusty saw that needs fixing. Are you bringing something?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I said I can spare an hour on Saturday. Just let me know what tools you need—I'll grab what I've got.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Bo! I think we'll need some wrenches and maybe a file for my saw. See you Saturday.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
